summary_one_line: DOJ secured a $440,000 consent decree against MedStar Health (DC/Maryland's largest hospital system) for ADA violations including inaccessible digital communications; decree required WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all posted web content.
notes: Primary claim was exclusion of disability support persons during COVID restrictions. However, the consent decree explicitly required MedStar to post all decree information on a WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant website — establishing digital accessibility obligations. This is a landmark healthcare enforcement action. Judge Julie R. Rubin approved the consent decree February 5, 2024. Complaint was filed January 10, 2024; consent decree filed January 17, 2024. MedStar operates 10 hospitals and 300+ outpatient locations in Maryland and Washington, DC.
